uncited: This family accelerates isosurface extraction by optimizing the order and grouping of ray-volume interactions to minimize redundant traversal and intersection tests.

It differs from naive uniform marching by using hierarchical acceleration structures (octrees, tiled grids) and spatial coherence (ray packets) to skip empty space and process multiple rays simultaneously.
